in_arabic.name: الإحياء
in_arabic.meaning: إحياء الحياة و الروح و الهداية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإحياء هو اسم مشتق من الفعل أحيا، و يعني إحياء الحياة و الروح و الهداية. و في القرآن الكريم، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالحياة و البعث و النشور. و في اللغة العربية، يدل على الإن оживление و التنشيط.

in_urdu.name: الاحیا
in_urdu.meaning: احیاء زندگی اور روح اور ہدایت
in_urdu.long_meaning: الاحیا ایک نام ہے جو احیا فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے زندگی اور روح اور ہدایت کا احیاء۔ اور قرآن کریم میں، یہ نام زندگی اور بعث اور نشور کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ اور عربی زبان میں، یہ زندگی کی نشونما اور تازگی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलइहया
in_hindi.meaning: अलइहया जीवन और आत्मा और मार्गदर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलइहया एक नाम है जो इहया क्रिया से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है जीवन और आत्मा और मार्गदर्शन का पुनरुत्थान। और कुरआन में, यह नाम जीवन और पुनरुत्थान और प्रबोधन से जुड़ा हुआ है। और अरबी भाषा में, यह जीवन की वृद्धि और ताजगी को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: الاحیا
in_pashto.meaning: د ژوند، روح او لارښوونې احیاء
in_pashto.long_meaning: الاحیا د احیاء د فعل څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، او د ژوند، روح او لارښوونې د احیاء معنی لري. او په قرآن کریم کې، دا نوم د ژوند او بیا راګرځولو او پوهاوی سره تړلی دی. او په عربي ژبه کې، دا د ژوند د ودې او تازوالي نښه ده.

in_english.name: AlIhya
in_english.meaning: Revival, bringing to life, spiritual guidance
in_english.long_meaning: AlIhya is a name derived from the Arabic root 'ahyā', which means to revive or bring to life. In the Quran, this concept is associated with spiritual guidance, resurrection, and the hereafter. The name AlIhya signifies the act of reviving or awakening, whether it be spiritual, moral, or intellectual. It embodies the qualities of rejuvenation, renewal, and enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "AlIhya" has a profound cultural significance in the Islamic world. In Arabic, the term "Al-Hayat" means 'life' and is used to refer to the present moment, life in this world, and the afterlife. The hyphenated form "AlIhya" is often used to denote preservers or gear toward enhancing and preserving 'life' in its fullest sense. This can manifest in various ways, from keeping traditional customs and traditions alive, to fostering a sense of community and respect for one another's wellbeing and spiritual growth. In the spiritual realm, AlIhya can be seen as a reminder of the importance of embodying life-affirming qualities, such as kindness, compassion, and generosity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "AlIhya" carries deep significance for Muslims. As the Islamic faith teaches, life is a precious gift from Allah, and one that should be lived in accordance with His will and guidance. The 'One Who Gives Life' can be seen as a reference to Allah, who creates and sustains all life. This name also emphasizes the importance of living in the present moment and cherishing every moment, for life is fleeting and uncertain. Additionally, as Muslims strive to live a life of good deeds and righteousness, they can call upon Allah as "AlIhya," asking for His help in sustaining and nurturing their spiritual health and growth. Ultimately, "AlIhya" serves as a constant reminder of the divine source of all life, and a call to live that life in a way that honors and reflects the infinite mercy and wisdom of Allah.
